<untrusted_participant_content>
I’m looking for an experienced AI Automation specialist who is strong in OpenAI, n8n, and building AI Agents.
I need someone who is truly expert in this stack because I want to build a reliable and scalable AI automation system that can handle complex workflows with minimal human involvement. The goal is to create intelligent agents and automated processes that actually work in a real production environment, not just basic demos.
You should be comfortable designing and developing advanced AI workflows, connecting multiple tools, and optimizing performance. Previous experience building production-level AI automations or agent systems is required.
Please start your proposal with the word “Aether” so I know you’ve read the full job post.
Also, kindly mention your current availability (hours per week and how soon you can start).
Looking forward to hearing from serious candidates only.
</untrusted_participant_content>
content.title: AI Automation Specialist OpenAI + n8n + AI Agents
